entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: If you don't care, it's garbage!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: If you do, it latches onto your soul[n]and never lets go! That is the essence[n]of gacha!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I-I see...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'm glad you're so passionate about[n]your interests.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Do you know what these are, Yusuke?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Futaba has told me a thing or two. I'm[n]not terribly familiar, but it does seem[n]rather intriguing.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Perhaps now is the time to give it a try.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: How exciting! I wonder what you'll get.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Now then...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: H-Hold on! It costs 500 yen...!?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Pardon me... I will need a moment to[n]collect myself.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Deep breaths... It is all for the sake of[n]inspirational discoveries...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Um, Yusuke...? Are you okay?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Worry not. I am now prepared to meet[n]my maker.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Let us begin the operation!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Eep... It feels like such a big deal now.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: The other day, I was looking at these[n]capsule machines and saw a Buchi—[n]Er, some random cute toy, so I tried it...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But it feels like you never get what you[n]actually want from these things.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: That's so true! It's like the more you[n]want it, the more impossible it is to get.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Ah, yes... This dark power has plagued[n]many a hero since ancient times. It is[n]known as... the desire sensor.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: I got a machine kinda like this in the store.[n]Pretty good source of extra income.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You mean the one with the shitty-lookin'[n]military food?

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: Watch your mouth. It's more popular[n]than you might think.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Wait... Seriously?

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: Sure. Never heard a complaint.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: They probably just go home and cry[n]themselves to sleep...

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Dang it! Another dupe!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Why don't you stop here?

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: No! It'll be fine. This next one's gonna[n]be the one!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I think that's called a "gambling[n]addiction"...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I gotta be careful around this guy.
